meta.title: Civicsmith experience inputs for UX design
readThis: Every line carries basis. 'fixed' means the canon or the approved module requirements say it, and src names where. 'open' means the canon does not settle it; the text is the question the design must answer. Nothing marked open has an invented answer.

Act references use the inventory's own names, written 'construct-id: Act name' (docs/development/ux-substrate/ux-substrate-v2.json). Screen inventory, act weights and working names are another worker's job and are not repeated here.

Two words mean two things. RUNG is how heavy an act is (reversible, reasoned, terminal, attested, irreversible). WEIGHT is how an act applied to a set behaves (refuse = all or nothing, report = proceed and say what moved, per-item = each applied or kept with its reason, single = one object). Source: affordances R1-R2; Interaction Constructs, naming collision corrected 2026-08-01.

'Finding' is overloaded: in case-making it is a concluded question; in the queue it is a class of item the record noticed and nobody has judged (inventory contradictions). This file says 'concluded finding' or 'queue finding' where it matters.
Coverage (useCases) says whether approved module requirements (build/requirements/*.md) hold the use case, not whether it is built.
Open questions carry a Bob-facing brief; settled ones carry a 'ruled' entry stating the design as it stands.

Where a line says 'decided' or 'decided, not built', Bob has ruled it but no approved requirement carries it yet; 'specified, not built' means the requirement is written and no tranche has built it; 'built at the plane' means built in the server with no member surface yet (the old interface, civicos-ui/app.html, is frozen by Bob's ruling K633 and gets no work).

neededIntro: These are the decisions about what members and readers see and do that only you can make. Each one opens to a full brief, written to stand on its own: what you are asked to decide; the basics you need, explained from scratch; how it works today; the problem and why it matters; a worked example with named people; what is already fixed and why; the choices, each traced through the same example with its gains, costs and what it commits you to; the trade-off in a sentence; a recommendation with its main risk; sample replies; and, at the end, the words used. Take them in any order; the table shows which are quick.

To answer, reply with the number and your ruling, for example “25: as recommended” or “34: Matters”. A question is just as welcome as a ruling. Each ruling is recorded, folded into the design documents, and this page is updated in the same change.

useCases.name: Search the record
useCases.goal: Find documents, passages, questions and legs by typing one query language.
useCases.trigger: A member wants something already held.
useCases.outcome: Rows the viewer may see, with facets, a note of what could not be seen, and widening when an AND finds nothing.

useCases.name: Search outside sources in one query (city data, legal databases, other groups, news)
useCases.goal: One question fans out to heterogeneous public sources with provenance and trust on each result.
useCases.trigger: A member does not yet hold the material.
useCases.outcome: Results with provenance, recency and trust signals, accepted into the record.
useCases.requirementIds: ai-runs R9-R14 (FIND only inside a run); capture-requests R1-R22
useCases.src: Functional Architecture 'Search across heterogeneous sources'; AI Roles section 2 (standalone FIND ABSENT)
useCases.coverageNote: No module holds a standalone fan-out search over outside sources; FIND exists only inside an investigative run.

useCases.name: Assemble what is known about a focus area (Context skill)
useCases.goal: Surface relevant laws, reports, other groups' work and request status for an area of interest.
useCases.trigger: A group orients on a new area.
useCases.outcome: An assembled landscape the member reviews.
useCases.src: Functional Architecture Layer 1 skills; Roadmap sections 9-10 (Orient); inventory inFlux ('Discovery ... beyond MVP')
useCases.coverageNote: No module requirement holds the Context skill.

useCases.name: Look up applicable laws and policies (Legal/Policy Lookup)
useCases.goal: Get candidate standards proposed for a government act, then adopt the right ones.
useCases.trigger: A question needs its legal frame.
useCases.outcome: Labelled proposals kept apart from standards until a member adopts.
useCases.src: Functional Architecture Layer 2 skills; standards Purpose
useCases.coverageNote: The proposal store is required; the lookup skill that produces proposals is not a module.

useCases.name: Discover other groups' published work and 'working on' signals
useCases.goal: Find related work in the network directory; signal what the group is working on.
useCases.outcome: Directory entries and signals.
useCases.src: Design Requirement 10; Roadmap section 11 (Inter-group awareness); Publication section 9 (directory not built)

useCases.name: Record a lead
useCases.goal: Write down what the member knows before searching, so looking has somewhere to start.
useCases.trigger: A member knows or suspects where something is.
useCases.outcome: A private lead readable by its author; never evidence.

useCases.name: Share a lead with a project and record looks at it
useCases.goal: Let a project work a lead and record each look's outcome.
useCases.trigger: A lead bears on a project.
useCases.outcome: Looks in order, with member-facing words for each state.

useCases.name: Read the frontier: what was looked for and what nobody looked at
useCases.goal: Tell which absence is true: nobody looked, looked and found nothing, could not tell, partial, present.
useCases.trigger: Before claiming something is missing, or before preparing a case's searched section.
acts: observation: Read the frontier (what was looked for, what nobody looked at)
useCases.outcome: Four levels (internet, documents, content, meaning) with look states and missing causes.
useCases.src: OBSERVATION-LOG-DESIGN sections 5-6; DEC-86 ('nobody looked' has its own treatment, distinct from Undetermined)

useCases.name: Capture a public document from its address
useCases.goal: Bring a document into the record with provenance: bytes hashed as they arrive, a receipt, a profile.
useCases.trigger: A member finds a document worth keeping.
acts: document: Capture from a public address
useCases.outcome: A collected document with its provenance chain and an earned capture grade (at most B for a direct fetch).
useCases.requirementIds: capture R2, R7-R18, R33-R36; provenance R24

useCases.name: Capture a page as a visitor saw it, from a web archive, or from a Drive link
useCases.goal: Capture sources that do not yield to a simple download.
useCases.trigger: A page renders in the browser, is gone, or lives on Drive.
acts: document: Capture from a public address
useCases.outcome: A rendered pair, an archive capture (grade C at most) or a Drive export, each saying what it is.
useCases.requirementIds: capture R3-R6, R41; capture-sources R1-R46; provenance R25

useCases.name: Supply a source login so a refused capture can succeed
useCases.goal: Unblock a capture that needs credentials, without the secret ever being shown back.
useCases.trigger: A capture request was refused for access.
useCases.outcome: The request retried under a scoped, encrypted, withdrawable credential.

useCases.name: Hand the group material through the doorbell (knock)
useCases.goal: Give material without an account.
useCases.trigger: Someone outside wants the group to have a document.
useCases.outcome: A receipt (knock id, digest, bytes, time); an inbox row; nothing in the record.
useCases.src: Intake Doctrine section 2a; DEC-78 (a knock has a source: an unnamed knocker identified by its receipt)
useCases.coverageNote: Adds the optional knocker secret (at least 20 characters, or one the doorbell makes and shows once) and the pseudonym in the answer.

useCases.name: Move a knock into the record, or discard it
useCases.goal: Read doorbell material and decide whether it becomes part of the record.
useCases.trigger: The doorbell inbox holds new knocks.
acts: knock: Pull: admit the material as a capture
useCases.outcome: Pulled material admitted as a capture at 'collected' carrying the knock's receipt (decided); a discarded knock can be put back to new.
useCases.requirementIds: capture R32, R65, R67, R70, R72; control-plane R36; provenance R19, R42, R51
useCases.src: Intake Doctrine section 2a; DEC-78 (pulling admits the knock's material as a capture carrying its receipt; vouching stays with release)
useCases.coverageNote: Built at the plane; the setup page's 'Mark as taken up' performs the pull (not app.html).

useCases.name: Record a firsthand observation (testimony)
useCases.goal: Put what the member saw or heard into the record in their own words.
useCases.outcome: A collected information bundle graded on the testimony axis, never a capture letter.

useCases.name: Read a document's extracted text and ask for a re-read
useCases.goal: See what the machine read, labelled as machine-read, and ask for OCR when text is missing.
useCases.trigger: Text is absent, partial or undetermined.
useCases.outcome: A reading with its content-axis state (indexed full, partial, none, not extracted, undetermined).
useCases.src: Functional Architecture Function 2; DEC-4 (machine-read text never presented as publisher text)

useCases.name: Point at the part of a document that matters (passage)
useCases.goal: Make a part of a document citable.
useCases.trigger: Only part of a document bears on a question.
useCases.outcome: A content row with its mint label (member-marked or machine work).

useCases.name: Type a transcription of a part; have a second member attest it
useCases.goal: Make an unreadable part citable as text, checked by someone else.
useCases.trigger: Machine text is missing or wrong.
acts: passage: Type a transcription of a part
useCases.outcome: A typed row; the typist cannot attest their own.

useCases.name: Register subjects and declare their relations
useCases.goal: Name the offices, funds, programs and people-in-role a case is about, with aliases and cited relations.
useCases.trigger: A new subject appears in the material.
acts: entity: Declare a relation, with justification and citation
useCases.outcome: Registry entries with no adversarial attribute.

useCases.name: Resolve a document's references to subjects
useCases.goal: Tie what a document names to registered subjects, graded by how the match was made.
useCases.trigger: A document has been captured and read.
acts: entity: Resolve a document's references to subjects
entity: Testify a match the recogniser missed (grade D)
useCases.outcome: Graded matches (A-C by recogniser, D only by member testimony); connections derived.

useCases.name: Declare where a document came from and whether its route can be shown
useCases.goal: Record the office or system a document came from, and assess its route.
acts: document: Declare which office/system it came from
document: Mark whether its route can be shown
useCases.outcome: An attributed declaration; undetermined stays stated.

useCases.name: Release (vouch for) a captured document
useCases.goal: Stand behind a capture after reviewing the source material itself, singly or in bulk with an acknowledgement.
useCases.outcome: The document moves collected to verified with a signed release.
useCases.requirementIds: affordances R1-R2 (weight refuse, rung reasoned); ratification R20-R27 (op=release)
useCases.src: UI-KICKOFF 'Who this is for' item 2; Interaction Constructs section J; DEC-87 (friction follows the rung)
useCases.coverageNote: Owned by ratification since T18 (R20-R27, the bulk release extracted from the store: K692); a crucial document is never in a batch, read from its own front matter too (N425, T19: K792). Built at the plane.

useCases.name: Retire a document
useCases.goal: Take a document out of use without erasing it.
useCases.trigger: A document is wrong or superseded.
useCases.outcome: A terminal state; refused while a live edge cites it.
useCases.requirementIds: affordances R1-R2; promotion R16; ratification R28-R33 (op=retire)
useCases.coverageNote: Owned by ratification since T19 (R28-R33, as built: a reason, only verified Information, never a document a live edge cites; K768, K830). Built at the plane.

useCases.name: Get a trusted timestamp or co-attest a capture
useCases.goal: Add third-party evidence of when bytes existed.
useCases.outcome: An attestation recorded; it never reaches Grade A.
useCases.src: DEC-39; Interaction Constructs section A; DEC-81 (a co-attested Grade B is enough to publish, disclosed on the case)

useCases.name: Declare an expected flow and thread documents into it
useCases.goal: Model how a body is supposed to act (e.g. minutes follow a meeting) and place the documents that show what happened.
useCases.trigger: A recurring process is under watch.
acts: progression: Declare or revise a flow
progression: Thread documents into an instance
useCases.outcome: Declared flow versus observed flow.

useCases.name: Declare themes and place material in them
useCases.goal: Organise material under a named theme with a test; the machine may propose placements.
acts: connection: Declare a theme with its test
connection: Place / propose / withdraw material in a theme
useCases.outcome: Themes that are never evidence.

useCases.name: Assert a connection or choose the on-point mention
useCases.goal: State that two documents are connected, or pick which mention is on point.
useCases.outcome: An attributed choice or assertion with a basis.

useCases.name: Classify material as fact, analysis or judgment
useCases.goal: Keep facts, analysis and judgment separate so each is treated correctly.
useCases.outcome: A classification that travels with the data.
useCases.src: Functional Architecture Layer 2 Function 3; Design Requirement 6 (content classification in metadata)
useCases.coverageNote: No module requirement names the fact / analysis / judgment classification.

useCases.name: Prove later what a public body published
useCases.goal: Keep bytes as served, hashed at receipt, so the record can prove what was available and when.
useCases.outcome: Content-addressed evidence and receipts.
useCases.requirementIds: capture R9, R34; provenance R1-R16, R35
useCases.src: Functional Architecture Function 3; System Design section 1

useCases.name: See the versions the record holds of one address

useCases.outcome: A version chain with predecessors.

useCases.name: Export the working corpus verifiably
useCases.goal: Move hosts, split or dissolve without losing the record.

useCases.outcome: A logged export; every administrator told (queue finding export-performed).
useCases.requirementIds: publication R18-R19, R32; queue R2; queue-producers R2 (export-performed)

useCases.name: Ask for a document to be monitored
useCases.goal: Watch a source at its own cadence (hourly to monthly, per meeting).
useCases.outcome: The document is on the daemon's plan.

useCases.name: Check a source now
useCases.goal: Force a check and see what changed.
useCases.outcome: A look recorded; modified, removed, unchanged or undetermined stated with why.

useCases.name: Be told a source was modified or removed
useCases.goal: Notice changes and removals (possible evidence of concealment), with both versions kept.
useCases.trigger: A monitoring tick flags a change.
useCases.outcome: Queue findings source-modified / source-removed homed under what rests on the document.
useCases.coverageNote: Built; monitoring R31's 'not yet met' mark is stale, since the producers are queue-producers'.

useCases.name: See every watched address, including unscheduled ones
useCases.goal: Know what is and is not being watched.
acts: monitoring: See every watched address, incl. unscheduled
useCases.outcome: A list of addresses with plan rows.

useCases.name: Keep named requests and ratified sweeps running
useCases.goal: Standing intent: fetch what a request or sweep names, on its cadence, within budget.
useCases.outcome: Captures at collected with anomaly notes.

useCases.name: Pause the daemon and read its due slate
useCases.goal: Stop fetching and see what would run; the manual path keeps tools optional.
useCases.outcome: A paused daemon that says so.
useCases.requirementIds: monitoring R30 (built T11-T13: the pause, N314 for every administrator, N324)

useCases.name: Watch the sources a finding rests on

useCases.outcome: A proposal to the owning members; never enabled by the machine.

useCases.name: Be told a newer version affects a passage I cited, then adopt or keep

useCases.outcome: A new version of the reference, or a recorded keep.
useCases.requirementIds: reevaluation R14-R15; content R29-R31; queue R1, R12; queue-producers R2

useCases.name: Re-evaluate findings when what they rest on changes

useCases.outcome: Obligations derived on read; a member's recorded re-evaluation closes a cause.
useCases.requirementIds: reevaluation R1-R16, R19-R21 (R17 'weakened' not yet met)
useCases.src: State Rules section 5.4; Functional Architecture Function 4 resolution note

useCases.name: Decide an obligation the record routed to me (authority, endorsement, expertise, ratification request)

acts: queue-item: Act on the subject directly
useCases.outcome: The act runs in its own surface; the task resolves.

useCases.name: Open a question
useCases.goal: Start an inquiry on what the member wants to know; the assistant may surface one within a run's bound.

useCases.name: Cite material into a question, supporting or cutting against
useCases.goal: Say 'this is why I think that', with legs whose grades are earned, not asserted.

useCases.goal: Cite only the part that matters; the machine may propose candidates.
acts: leg: Narrow to the on-point part
useCases.outcome: A new suggested version derived from the old.

acts: strength: Read strength of a question or version
useCases.outcome: Per-axis grades; unrated and undetermined stated; what-ifs labelled.

useCases.goal: Choose which accepted account the project stands on.
acts: basis-version: Make current for a project
useCases.outcome: The project's CURRENT; other projects unaffected.

useCases.outcome: An appended withdrawal row.

useCases.outcome: A reopened question saying who reopened it.

journeyExperience.journey: (a) A group sets up and invites members
journeyExperience.spans: days; several people (operator, founder, second administrator, members)

steps.step: Install the signed release into the group's account
steps.whatTheyKnow: Needs a paid account with a payment method; the page states prerequisites.
steps.decisionTheyMake: Which slug to use (written once, public forever) and which jurisdiction profiles to offer.
whatCanGoWrong: Existing copy for the slug: refused, nothing changed (installer R5).
No payment method: refused, saying nothing was created (installer R4, R7).
Account already holds a copy: refused until installs are isolated (installer R32).
A part not serving the release: named, not claimed as done (installer R15, R33).
steps.howLong: One sitting; up to ten self-test tries.
steps.feelingRisk: The slug is public and permanent; a group wanting anonymity must choose an unrevealing one now.
steps.src: installer R2-R16, R21-R24, R32-R33; Publication section 7 point 1
openInThisStep: How the operator is told, in plain words, that the slug is permanent and public at the moment of choosing.

steps.step: Open the setup page and claim with the one-time password
steps.whatTheyKnow: Holds the password (the link may carry it as #boot=).
steps.decisionTheyMake: Choose a password of at least 12 characters.
whatCanGoWrong: ALREADY_CLAIMED (membership R1).
PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT.
The page could not read the group: says so, never 'none recorded' (instance-setup R20).
steps.feelingRisk: The founder becomes the root of trust with no custody model (DEC-2 deferred).
steps.src: membership R1; instance-setup R20-R22; control-plane R15

steps.step: Set display name, domain and jurisdiction profiles
steps.whatTheyKnow: The slug; the held profiles by name and coverage.
steps.decisionTheyMake: What the group calls itself; which domain to claim; which profiles (none preselected).
whatCanGoWrong: GROUP_DISPLAY_NAME_MALFORMED.
Domain verdict absent, mismatched or UNDETERMINED: not shown publicly; members see the state (instance-setup R8-R10).
Changing profiles changes how local facts read (warning; instance-setup R15).
steps.feelingRisk: Showing an unverified domain would claim an association the record cannot support.
steps.src: instance-setup R5-R16; Publication section 7 (profiles built T12, N10)

steps.step: Add a second administrator (direct while fewer than two)
steps.whatTheyKnow: The floor is two administrators.
steps.decisionTheyMake: Who, with what cover (not a legal name).
whatCanGoWrong: NOT_AN_ADMIN.
Cover typed as a legal name defeats the protection (Membership v2 section 3).
steps.howLong: Minutes; then waits for the invitee.
steps.feelingRisk: Cover invites a legal name if the field is worded badly.

steps.step: Record who holds hosting access
steps.whoIsActing: the group, asked when the second administrator is added
steps.whatTheyKnow: Hosting access is outside the app.
whatCanGoWrong: Left unanswered: the record keeps whatever answer was given.
steps.feelingRisk: None named in canon.
openInThisStep: What the group is told about why this matters (the hosting account is the remedy against the founder).

steps.step: Add members with capabilities (default contribute)
steps.whatTheyKnow: Capabilities: contribute, publish, create_projects.
whatCanGoWrong: At two or more administrators, a new administrator is only proposed and needs a ballot (membership R14).
BAD_CAPABILITY.
steps.handoffTo: invitee (burner URL sent by a channel the system does not record)
steps.feelingRisk: None named.
steps.src: membership R9, R12-R15; Membership v2 section 6

steps.step: Open the link, choose handle and password
steps.whatTheyKnow: Sees cover, role, capabilities and expertise; never the member id.
steps.decisionTheyMake: Handle (public in the record) and password.
whatCanGoWrong: NO_SUCH_INVITATION (spent or never existed, one answer).
HANDLE_TAKEN.
BAD_HANDLE.
PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT.
ENROL_NOT_RECORDED: the enrolment could not be completed, nothing changed, and the invitation link still works (membership R95; T19: K778).
steps.howLong: Minutes; the link is spent on use.
steps.feelingRisk: The handle is what the public sees; the member may not realise.
steps.src: membership R15-R16; Membership v2 section 3; membership R95 (K778)
openInThisStep: What a newcomer learns first is deferred until the redesign is built and stable (DEC-91); meanwhile strength against the bar and 'Undetermined' come first (DEC-82).

steps.step: Create a project with an objective
steps.whatTheyKnow: A project name is unique across the instance.
whatCanGoWrong: NAME_TAKEN.
A project with no objective is refused (intent R1).
steps.feelingRisk: Members may believe projects are private; visibility is organisation, not secrecy.
steps.src: promotion R19; intent R1; membership R71; Membership v2 section 2

steps.step: Invite participants; they join
steps.whatTheyKnow: Handles.
whatCanGoWrong: NOT_THE_OWNER.
NO_SUCH_HANDLE.
ALREADY_A_PARTICIPANT.
NOT_INVITED on join.
steps.feelingRisk: None named.

steps.step: Make the project discoverable; an outsider requests to join; owner grants
steps.whatTheyKnow: Outsiders see the name only.
steps.decisionTheyMake: Whether to expose the name; whether to grant.
whatCanGoWrong: PROJECT_SEEN_NOT_A_PARTICIPANT (C-70.1) for acts beyond existence.
A grant invites; the requester still has to join (membership R51).
steps.feelingRisk: Exposing a name tells every member the project exists.

journeyExperience.journey: (b) From a question to a published case
journeyExperience.spans: weeks; several members, possibly an outside reviewer

steps.step: Capture a public document
steps.whatTheyKnow: An address.
whatCanGoWrong: BAD_LOCATOR.
HOST_COOLING_OFF: the governor paces the host (capture R7).
Source refused or fetch failed, recorded as such (capture R8).
Rendered content UNDETERMINED; archive capture at most C.
steps.howLong: Seconds to minutes; renders may be deferred.
steps.feelingRisk: A capture is not evidence until a member stands behind it; the grade note may be discarded before the member sees it (DEC-51).
steps.src: capture R2-R18; AI Roles rule 4; DEC-51

steps.step: Release it (vouch for it)
steps.whatTheyKnow: Must see the source material itself, never only an AI summary.
steps.decisionTheyMake: Stand behind it, with acknowledgement and mitigation for a bulk release.
whatCanGoWrong: Refused whole, with offenders named (weight refuse: all or nothing): not Information, not collected, crucial (read from the document's own front matter too), or missing an entry requirement (ratification R22-R23; N425).
A machine, or an empty or over-long acknowledgment or mitigation, is refused before anything is read (MACHINE_CANNOT_RELEASE, NO_ACKNOWLEDGMENT, NO_MITIGATION; ratification R20).
A second member released first: CAS_STALE (promotion R1).
steps.feelingRisk: Click-through bulk release would make the acknowledgement dishonest.
steps.src: UI-KICKOFF item 2; Interaction Constructs section J; affordances R1-R2; ratification R20-R27 (K692; N425, K792)
openInThisStep: A failure partway leaves the documents already released released, and names them (ratification R25): how the screen shows that is the redesign's.

steps.step: Resolve its references to subjects
steps.whatTheyKnow: Recognised references with grades.
steps.decisionTheyMake: Accept matches; testify a missed one (grade D).
whatCanGoWrong: Ambiguous alias kept, never resolved silently (entities R6).
A C match never reads established.
steps.feelingRisk: One click from an established resolution off a machine-composed list (DEC-53).

steps.step: Open a question (or the assistant surfaces one)
steps.whatTheyKnow: What they want to know.
whatCanGoWrong: Surfaced by the assistant: must look surfaced; ages to deferred if nobody acts (intent R17).
steps.howLong: Minutes; ageing interval set per instance.
steps.feelingRisk: A machine question must not read as a member's obligation (D-82).
steps.src: inquiry R1-R2; ai-runs R25-R27; intent R16-R17

steps.step: Cite documents, passages or questions as supporting or cutting against
steps.whatTheyKnow: Earned grades per target.
whatCanGoWrong: RETIRED_NOT_CITABLE.
A grouped question refuses a new leg until ungrouped (DEC-50).
A newer capture may exist: stale version notice.
A supporting and a cutting-against leg that conflict carry a tension mark; the clarifier asks how they differ (decided: DEC-77).
steps.feelingRisk: Stating a grade the record did not earn: the leg is capped and why is shown.

steps.step: Open an assistant run to check or investigate
steps.whatTheyKnow: The run's bounds, lens and bar are recorded at open.
whatCanGoWrong: Mode not deployed: refused (ai-runs R40).
A bound stops the run and the log says which.
Capture requests wait on the daemon (hours).
steps.feelingRisk: The assistant appearing to conclude; transcripts are notes, never record.
steps.src: ai-runs R9-R24, R40; AI Roles section 3

steps.step: Accept a version (after the shared-origin check)
steps.whatTheyKnow: Versions with legs and per-axis strength; suggested ones labelled.
steps.decisionTheyMake: Accept, reject, consider, revert; preview first.
whatCanGoWrong: VERSION_* refusals; MACHINE_CANNOT_MOVE_VERSION for a machine.
Grounds that share an origin.
steps.feelingRisk: Accepting a machine suggestion without reading it (DEC-68: the record cannot tell).

steps.step: Make it current for the project
steps.whatTheyKnow: Which version is accepted.
steps.decisionTheyMake: Which account the project stands on.
whatCanGoWrong: VERSION_NOT_ACCEPTED.
Not a joined participant.
steps.feelingRisk: None named.

steps.step: Conclude, stating what would falsify it (or that nothing would)
steps.whatTheyKnow: The current version and its strength.
whatCanGoWrong: MACHINE_CANNOT_CONCLUDE.
NO_CLAIM.
Another project concluded differently: both stances stand.
steps.feelingRisk: False certainty: a falsifier of 'none' must be the member's stated override.

steps.step: Check strength against the bar; clear hunches
steps.whatTheyKnow: Per-axis pair per load-bearing finding; the project bar.
steps.decisionTheyMake: Which findings are load-bearing; which hunches to clear.
whatCanGoWrong: BELOW_PROJECT_STRENGTH naming member, axis, required and reached (case-authoring R6).
UNCLEARED_HUNCH (not yet enforced; lands with the ceremony's pre-flight, DEC-80 item 3).
steps.howLong: Days if more evidence is needed.
steps.feelingRisk: Over-claiming: a case over an uncleared hunch states a strength that is not true.
steps.src: case-authoring R6, R12; strength R5; DEC-20

steps.step: Draft a review copy; grant outside reviewers
steps.whatTheyKnow: The copy is complete as a publication can be and names what is missing.
steps.decisionTheyMake: Whom to grant; when to revoke.
whatCanGoWrong: Grant dies if the draft moves case identity (review R8).
Recipient sees findings as the last editor could, absent ones by role only.
steps.feelingRisk: Calling it 'pre-publish' asserts a future that may not happen.

steps.step: Prepare the case: scope, statement, exclusions, bias acknowledgement
steps.whatTheyKnow: Concluded findings; the searched section computed from the log.
steps.decisionTheyMake: Roles, scope, what is left out and why.
whatCanGoWrong: COMPLETENESS_CARRIED_FORWARD (byte-identical to last edition).
CASE_SEARCHED_UNCOMPUTABLE.
ALREADY_A_CASE_MEMBER.
CASE_IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS.
steps.feelingRisk: Nothing may draft framing for the member (Case Making section 4a).

steps.step: Acknowledge the exclusion statement
steps.whoIsActing: joined participant or review recipient (not its writer)
steps.whatTheyKnow: The statement, shown first.
whatCanGoWrong: STATEMENT_ACK_BY_ITS_AUTHOR.
STATEMENT_ACK_NOT_A_PARTICIPANT.
STATEMENT_ACK_ALREADY_SIGNED.
STATEMENT_ACK_AUTHOR_UNDETERMINED.
steps.feelingRisk: A gate pushing a one-person group to recruit a signature would be a bug; nobody-but-author is disclosed, not refused.

steps.step: Go through the publication ceremony and sign in the browser
steps.whatTheyKnow: Before the first screen, what would stop publication (the pre-flight). Then: what becomes permanent; what it rests on; what it leaves out, including any unresolved record contradiction to disclose and consent for any source identity it would reveal; the edition it creates (DEC-80 item 2).
steps.decisionTheyMake: Disclose, acknowledge, and sign now or not.
whatCanGoWrong: NO_SIGNERS.
CASE_RATIFY_STALE (an acknowledgement or edit re-authored it).
ATTRIBUTION_UNCHOSEN / ATTRIBUTION_STATEMENT_STALE.
OPERATOR_TOKEN_CANNOT_RATIFY_CASE.
CASE_CONCLUSION_MOVED.
An undisclosed open record tension refuses the case; a disclosed one does not (DEC-84 (13)).
A load-bearing document whose co-attestation failed: retried, then acknowledged with a reason and marked 'self-attested only' (DEC-81 item 3).
A finding rests on a side in conflict with a record the owner cannot see: told in the ceremony, highlighted in the case, never naming that record (DEC-85).

mustShow.text: Four parts, top to bottom: Subjects, Options, Scenarios, Started.

The checks in words under the title, each linking to what it is about: a regulated date past or before its phase can start; a judgement with no branch for one outcome; an option bound only to subjects no longer live; an outward option bound only to hypothetical subjects; a scenario with no branch answering a hostile response; a lobbying option whose target is superseded. A check informs and never refuses.
Each subject's support in words (established, short, 'hypothetical: not yet shown') and its liveness; a plan resting only on hypothetical subjects says so at the top, as hunch debt.
Each option's category, subjects served, regulated dates with their basis, disposition and origin (member or assistant).

Options collapsed to summary, category and dates; expanded: detail, addressee, subjects served, where it came from and its history; sortable by category, regulated start or end date, subject or disposition.
A declined option keeps its reason and stays visible.
Legal options show the profile's venues and legal organisations beside them, labelled as facts, never recommendations.
